directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded.name: directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded
directory_entries_ciphertext_bounded.value:
length("directory_entries"."name_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND length("directory_entries"."order_ciphertext") BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
    AND length("directory_entries"."key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384

file_representations_head_complete.name: file_representations_head_complete
file_representations_head_complete.value:
("file_representations"."key_envelope" IS NULL AND "file_representations"."head_digest" IS NULL
    AND "file_representations"."head_signature" IS NULL AND "file_representations"."head_device_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("file_representations"."key_envelope" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."key_envelope") BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
      AND "file_representations"."head_digest" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."head_digest") = 32
      AND "file_representations"."head_signature" IS NOT NULL AND length("file_representations"."head_signature") = 64 AND "file_representations"."head_device_id" IS NOT NULL)

files_capability_pair.name: files_capability_pair
files_capability_pair.value:
("files"."capability_id" IS NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" IS NULL)
    OR ("files"."capability_id" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."capability_epoch" >= 1)

rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid.name: rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid
rate_limit_counters_purpose_scope_valid.value:
("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" IN ('registration.challenge', 'registration.success') AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'webauthn.sign_in' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'recovery.attempt' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'recovery_identifier'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'vault_recovery.start' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'session.refresh' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'session')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'public_comment.mutate' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'network', 'account', 'publication', 'account_publication'))
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'public_comment.report' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."purpose" = 'publication.mutate' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account')

rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid.name: rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid
rate_limit_counters_scope_id_valid.value:
("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'global' AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" = '*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'network' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 72
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 8) = 'network:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'session' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 72
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 8) = 'session:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'recovery_identifier' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 84
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 20) = 'recovery_identifier:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 21) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account_publication' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 84
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 1, 20) = 'account_publication:'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 21) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'account' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 36
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 9, 1) = '-' AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 14, 1) = '-'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 15, 1) = '7' AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 19, 1) = '-'
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')
          AND substr("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id", 24, 1) = '-'
          AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*')
        OR ("rate_limit_counters"."scope_type" = 'publication' AND length("rate_limit_counters"."scope_id") = 43
          AND "rate_limit_counters"."scope_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')

security_events_account_id_opaque.name: security_events_account_id_opaque
security_events_account_id_opaque.value:
"security_events"."account_id" IS NULL OR (length("security_events"."account_id") = 36
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 9, 1) = '-' AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 14, 1) = '-'
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 15, 1) = '7' AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 19, 1) = '-'
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 20, 1) IN ('8', '9', 'a', 'b')
        AND substr("security_events"."account_id", 24, 1) = '-'
        AND "security_events"."account_id" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*')

security_events_publication_id_opaque.name: security_events_publication_id_opaque
security_events_publication_id_opaque.value:
"security_events"."publication_id" IS NULL OR (length("security_events"."publication_id") = 43
        AND "security_events"."publication_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*')

security_events_network_bucket_bounded.name: security_events_network_bucket_bounded
security_events_network_bucket_bounded.value:
("security_events"."network_bucket" IS NULL AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("security_events"."network_bucket" IS NOT NULL AND length("security_events"."network_bucket") = 72
          AND substr("security_events"."network_bucket", 1, 8) = 'network:'
          AND substr("security_events"."network_bucket", 9) NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*'
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" >= "security_events"."created_at"
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" <= "security_events"."created_at" + 86400000
          AND "security_events"."network_bucket_expires_at" <= "security_events"."expires_at")

sharing_comment_capabilities_context.name: sharing_comment_capabilities_context
sharing_comment_capabilities_context.value:
("sharing_comment_capabilities"."purpose" = 'private-comment-thread'
    AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."publication_id" IS NULL AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."object_id" = "sharing_comment_capabilities"."thread_id") OR
    ("sharing_comment_capabilities"."purpose" = 'public-comment-audience-epoch' AND "sharing_comment_capabilities"."publication_id" IS NOT NULL)
